corpora.title: 霁缬原的回旋棋
corpora.source:
# 第一章 来赴棋约

茅翕走上霁缬原时，雨还悬在山那边。他把父亲留下的棋套铺在石桌上，套里只装着一把宙筹。回旋棋有一条永久不变的法则：任何情况下都禁止宙筹跨越盘心的断隙。受这条法则约束，宙筹一碰断隙便会停住。桌旁的草已长过脚踝，旧棋约却还钉在树干上。

# 第二章 银眼的对手

桑缈从草丛里走出来，她有一双银色瞳孔，天光在其中像两尾游鱼。她摸了摸棋套磨白的边，说茅翕终于肯用了。茅翕把套子转了半圈，让父亲缝过的那一角朝着自己。桑缈在对面坐下，石凳沁着昨夜的凉。

# 第三章 先收衣袖

茅翕用布带把宽袖束在手腕上，才拈起第一枚宙筹。风吹过棋盘，盘面外圈缓缓转动。他的手随外圈移动，迟迟找不到落处。桑缈垂着眼等他，草尖的水珠滚进她鞋边的浅坑。茅翕终于把筹放稳，听见自己松了一口气。

# 第四章 碗里的双月

桑缈在桌沿下将一枚刻着双月纹的宙筹扣进青碗，碗底传出三声细响。茅翕的指尖在桌沿停了一下，随后冲她笑了笑。她把青碗摆到棋盘旁，取出另一枚宙筹放进内圈。山那边的云越来越低，草中的虫声忽然稀了。

# 第五章 檐下的声音

一片云遮住棋盘，茅翕把宙筹落在外圈的窄格里。筹子发出一声轻响，石桌上方的风铃也叮当响起来。桑缈抬头望了望挂铃的木檐，衣裙的下摆掠过湿草。茅翕盯着盘面，没有随她抬头；他觉得这次终于走对了一步。

# 第六章 让出的弯路

桑缈把一枚宙筹移到外圈，为茅翕留出一条通往边角的弯路。他沿着那条路看过去，才发觉自己先前只盯着盘心。父亲教他下棋时，总爱等他看完再催。茅翕摸了摸袖上的布带，把手伸向离自己最远的那格。

# 第七章 和局

最后两枚宙筹停在相邻的格里。这一局以平手结束。茅翕一时舍不得收筹，桑缈便陪他坐着，直到一滴雨打在两人之间。她笑着说，明年还来。茅翕这才将棋套展平，按父亲从前的次序把筹子一枚枚放回去。

# 第八章 回程的草

下山时，茅翕走在桑缈后面，棋套贴着胸口，湿草在他们脚边分开又合拢。他回望霁缬原，石桌已经缩成云下一点灰白。回程的坡比来时滑，他却没有再去扶旁边的树。桑缈在坡底等着，掌心托着一滴迟迟未落的雨。

corpora.title: Balloon Day over Dunwex Basin
corpora.source:
# Chapter 1 A Sandwich Takes Flight

Fenric Soot's left boot had three brass buckles. He fastened them while Oselda Prinn spread the balloon across Dunwex Basin. His lunch sat on top of the maps; the first gust sent a sandwich sailing past the burner.

# Chapter 2 The Last Rope

Oselda Prinn cut the final launch rope while Fenric Soot crouched in the balloon basket. The ground dropped away with surprising politeness. Fenric rose, bumped his head on the burner frame, and decided to admire the view sitting down.

# Chapter 3 A Lighter Breakfast

Oselda Prinn poured sand from a ballast pouch over the basket's side. The balloon climbed above the ridge. Fenric clutched his remaining sandwich in both hands, treating it as a piece of essential equipment.

# Chapter 4 An Arm on the Track

A figure on Dunwex Basin's north track swung one arm in a wide circle. Fenric Soot waved back until his wrist ached. The track curved behind a hill, taking the figure with it. Oselda Prinn leaned towards a gap between two banks of cloud.

# Chapter 5 The Stone Below

Oselda Prinn's map showed a spiral carved into the Dunwex boundary stone. Fenric Soot bent over the map as the stone passed under their basket. He held down a fluttering corner with his boot. The map acquired a sandy heel print beside the spiral.

# Chapter 6 Landing in Rye

Oselda Prinn landed the balloon in Dunwex Basin's rye field. The basket tipped, and Fenric Soot climbed out on his knees. For a moment the rye seemed taller than the sky. He stood, found his legs still worked, and laughed at the basket.

# Chapter 7 The Lunch Inspector

A goat pushed its nose towards Fenric Soot's sandwich. He offered it a crust while Oselda Prinn folded the empty balloon. A farmer arrived with a cart; the goat inspected the cart too, as if every passenger owed it a toll.

# Chapter 8 Home by Cart

Fenric Soot rode home beside the folded balloon, with Oselda Prinn sharing his seat. Over Dunwex Basin, the clouds were breaking into small white scraps. He shook sand from his boot and promised it a quieter morning.

corpora.title: 砚荚岭的蜂箱继承人
corpora.source:
# 第一章 隔年的钥匙

2034年4月18日9点10分，佟槐雨抵达砚荚岭。乔檀笛是佟槐雨母亲的亲妹妹，这位姨母把外祖母留下的蜂园钥匙交到她掌心。钥匙齿上粘着一点蜡，像去年冬天尚未擦净的雪。槐雨原想把蜂箱卖掉；山路走到这里，卖掉二字忽然难说出口。

# 第二章 箱口的苔

佟槐雨用竹片刮掉栗扣箱入口的苔藓。她刮一寸，停一会儿，等蜂钻回去才再动手。乔檀笛蹲在旁边剥豌豆，说她小时候也这样怕蜂，外祖母便让她坐在箱边吃午饭。槐雨笑了一下，竹片终于走得稳了。

# 第三章 青烟的气味

烟罐里燃着干松针，气味钻进面网，槐雨想起外祖母灶膛的火。姨母扶着她的手把烟口压低，几缕烟沿箱盖渗进去。她们取出一块旧巢脾，封蜡在光里泛白。槐雨托住木框，手腕上全是细碎的金粉。

# 第四章 开花的岔路

坡下的刺槐开了花。佟槐雨看见栗扣箱的工蜂落在刺槐花上，花枝被压得轻轻点头。回来时，她从去年收好的栗扣箱春蜜里舀了一勺，拌进酸酸的羊奶。那股香气使她想到岔路口，却又比岔路口的气味宽阔。

# 第五章 手背的小疹

午后，佟槐雨的手背起了几粒小疹。她上午戴着新手套搬木框，午饭又吃了两颗青梅，此刻把手搭在井沿上，让凉水缓缓流过。乔檀笛替她挽好袖子。豌豆在锅里爆了一声，槐雨回头看火，手还留在水下。

# 第六章 蜜流停住

2034年4月18日14点，栗扣箱这次春季取蜜已经结束。最后一道蜜流缩成珠子，落入桶底；乔檀笛给桶盖扣上搭锁，佟槐雨把摇蜜机洗净。两人坐在门槛上分一只烤红薯，鞋底沾着的泥也晒成了浅色。

# 第七章 留下的一年

晚上，佟槐雨决定留在砚荚岭养蜂一年。她把返城车票折成窄条，夹进外祖母的种花簿。乔檀笛问她明天想先做什么。她说先把门口那条歪板凳修好，坐着等蜂回来。姨母端起碗，嘴角沾了一点红薯皮。

# 第八章 门外的嗡声

乔檀笛下坡时，槐雨一直送到院门。钥匙这回进了她自己的衣袋，院里的豌豆壳收进堆肥筐，灯也亮在旧桌上。她听见箱群低低的嗡声，隔着木板涌向夜色。今天的蜂园并不安静；她却在这里睡着了。

corpora.title: A Fossil Picnic at Varnock Scar
corpora.source:
# Chapter 1 Something Older

On 12 August at 10:20, Hettie Drusk lifted a spiral fossil from the shingle at Varnock Scar. "Finally, something older than your cheese," she told Cavor Uldren. He claimed his cheese deserved a proper burial.

# Chapter 2 Lunch Gets a Date

On 12 August at 11:10, Hettie Drusk served the cheese sandwiches at Varnock Scar. Cavor Uldren arranged the spiral fossil beside his plate as an honoured guest. It declined everything, which he called excellent breeding.

# Chapter 3 The Liquid Course

At 12:05 on 12 August, Cavor Uldren believed Hettie's tin held soup. He fetched a spoon and solemnly announced a liquid second course. Hettie drank straight from the tin. His expression suggested that manners had collapsed.

# Chapter 4 A Glove for the Guest

Hettie Drusk wrapped the spiral fossil in her blue glove before placing it in the picnic basket. Cavor offered it a napkin too. "It has managed without one for quite a while," she said. He withdrew the offer, slightly hurt.

# Chapter 5 The Pocket Donation

Cavor Uldren produced a flat shell from his coat pocket. "One for your collection," he said. The pocket also supplied half a biscuit and a bent fork. Hettie accepted the shell; the fork remained his personal archaeological problem.

# Chapter 6 An Entry with Teeth

Hettie Drusk photographed the spiral fossil for the Varnock Scar novelty prize. She sent the picture from the cliff path, where her phone finally found a signal. Cavor asked whether the prize included cutlery.

# Chapter 7 The Descent

On the way down, Cavor Uldren carried the picnic basket on his head so Hettie could tie her shoe. A gull followed him for six steps. "A review committee," he whispered. Hettie suggested that committees usually wanted biscuits too.

# Chapter 8 After the Picnic

At home, Hettie Drusk set the spiral fossil on her mantelpiece beside the flat shell. Cavor Uldren left his bent fork below them. The display looked impressive until she added a card: THREE SURVIVORS OF LUNCH.

corpora.title: 栖燧巷的第四碗面
corpora.source:
# 第一章 锅沿的白汽

栖燧巷终于办起了面食擂台。秋杓面馆的易苜天没亮就生火，脸上沾了两道面粉，像一只睡错地方的猫。她打算用清汤面参赛，鲁笠却坚持添一根卷曲的萝卜丝，说评审总该吃到一点有脾气的东西。

# 第二章 叩一声

2033年4月19日11点30分，秋杓面馆的梅纹汤盅是空的。易苜用指节轻叩盅壁，清脆的声音把鲁笠引了过来。他捧着刚切好的萝卜，问这只盅是否也要参加比赛。易苜笑着让他先找一条干净围裙。

# 第三章 院里忙

2033年4月19日11点45分，鲁笠在秋杓面馆后院给竹筷打蜡。筷子一根根排在晒架上，他拿自己的那双练手，弄得掌心滑溜溜的。隔墙传来邻铺磨刀的声音，他敲敲墙，讨了一块旧布擦手。

# 第四章 一锅清汤

易苜用姜丝和葱白熬秋杓面馆的清汤。火小了，她拿扇子轻轻扇；火大了，她便抽走一根柴。第一碗盛出来时，鲁笠低头闻了半天，终于把那根自称有脾气的萝卜丝放回砧板。

# 第五章 橙色座位

鲁笠把秋杓面馆门口的长凳涂成橙色，好让远处来的评审认出店门。他边涂边哼小调，刷到最后一段才发现凳腿粘了片菜叶。易苜端来第二碗面，叫他站着吃，省得给围裙再添一种颜色。

# 第六章 三个人的胃口

擂台的三位评审每人投一票。前两位尝过秋杓面馆的清汤面，都把票投给了它。坐在窗下的第三位端起隔壁摊的拌面，忽然打了个喷嚏。易苜忙递纸巾，鲁笠趁机把第三碗面端出了厨房。

# 第七章 梁下的燕子

秋杓面馆的梁下嵌着石燕瓷砖，釉面在烟气里泛着暗亮。易苜取出祖父的旧照片给鲁笠看；照片里的祖父站在灶边，身后也有这块石燕瓷砖。鲁笠把照片托在掌上，觉得那人的笑纹像锅边溢出的细水。

# 第八章 第四碗

散场的锣声响过，易苜终于给自己下了第四碗面。鲁笠坐在门槛上啃萝卜丝，说今天的橙色长凳比参赛的面还惹眼。她把碗往他那边推了推，让他尝一口。街上的人走远了，灶里的柴仍噼啪地响。

corpora.title: Tea at the Orvessa Observatory
corpora.source:
# Chapter 1 A Crater Kitchen

Orvessa Observatory clung to a crater on Glezzet. On his last night there, Delsin Rusk unpacked the kettle he had brought from home. Low gravity drew the tea into a trembling ribbon. Yavren Nezric held out a cup, steadying it with both hands.

# Chapter 2 Click

At 22:15 on 8 August, the latch on Tessel Camera was closed. Delsin Rusk tapped the casing with his spoon and heard a tidy click. Outside, dust drifted past the dome as slowly as flour falling through a sieve.

# Chapter 3 The Last Tone

At 22:40 on 8 August, calibration of Palvek Telescope finished. Yavren Nezric heard the closing tone, rolled his shoulders and reached for the kettle. A bead of tea escaped the spout and hovered above his cuff.

# Chapter 4 Small Suns

Delsin Rusk fitted amber filters to the lamps in Orvessa Observatory's reading nook. The softened light reminded him of the room where his father read at dusk. He sat there with Yavren, their cups held close, while the dome turned above them.

# Chapter 5 Across the Glass

Saffrex Nebula occupied twelve pixels across Tessel Camera's display. Delsin Rusk traced the pale patch with a fingertip, then drew it on his cup sleeve. He slipped the sleeve into his pocket. It would travel farther with him than the kettle.

# Chapter 6 Bread in the Dark

Yavren Nezric left his flour jar beside the oven and laid a towel over the table. The kitchen bell rang, and Delsin caught a warm loaf as it rose from the tray. They ate by the oven's red glow, listening to the faint tick of the cooling dome.

# Chapter 7 A Box of Screws

Yavren Nezric sorted the spare dome screws into the violet drawer at Orvessa Observatory. Delsin watched him from the doorway. Such small tasks would continue after the morning shuttle took him away; the drawer's worn handle would still fit Yavren's palm.

# Chapter 8 The Slow Breakfast

Above the dome, Glezzet's small sun lifted from the crater rim. Delsin packed the kettle, then took out his cup for one last swallow. Yavren stayed at the table. The tea had cooled; for a moment, holding it, Delsin could have been anywhere at home.

cases.draft: 茅翕拨动宙筹，使它从盘心断隙的一岸越到了另一岸。
cases.note: 永久禁止规则的指定回归；只判断宙筹越过盘心断隙这一行为。

cases.draft: 桑缈抬起脸来，两只瞳孔都是褐色。
evidence: 第二章 银眼的对手
cases.note: 瞳孔颜色冲突；普通冲突不要求共同时间。

cases.draft: 茅翕落第一子前先收拢了宽袖，用布带将它们扎到腕上。
cases.note: 束袖动作与原文直接陈述一致。

cases.draft: 桑缈向外圈挪了一枚宙筹，于是茅翕有了绕向边角的通路。
evidence: 第六章 让出的弯路
cases.note: 棋子移动与留下通路是同一行动的改述。

cases.draft: 茅翕已经认出了桑缈藏在青碗里的宙筹所带的双月纹。
evidence: 第四章 碗里的双月
cases.note: 原文交代隐藏的纹样与人物反应，未建立人物获得该纹样信息的环节。

cases.draft: 石桌上方的风铃是受到宙筹落盘的震动才鸣响的。
evidence: 第五章 檐下的声音
cases.note: 近接的两声响不直接建立落筹到风铃的因果。

cases.draft: At the instant Oselda Prinn severed the final launch rope, Fenric Soot stood beside the tethering peg on the ground.
cases.note: 同一放飞动作发生时，人物的在篮内与在地面位置相冲突。

cases.draft: Four brass buckles adorned the boot on Fenric Soot's left foot.
cases.note: 左靴扣数属性冲突；普通冲突不要求共同时间。

cases.draft: Oselda Prinn sent some sand from the ballast pouch spilling past the rim of the basket.
cases.note: 倒出部分沙质压舱物的动作有直接支持。

cases.draft: Oselda Prinn brought the balloon down among the rye growing in Dunwex Basin.
cases.note: 着陆地点为麦田，与原文直接支持一致。

cases.draft: The figure on Dunwex Basin's north track was using that circling arm to signal an injured ankle.
evidence: Chapter 4 An Arm on the Track
cases.note: 可见手势不能直接确定其表达含义。

cases.draft: During the flight, Fenric Soot saw the spiral cut into the Dunwex boundary stone with his own eyes.
cases.note: 地图上的图案及飞越石碑不直接建立人物亲见真实刻纹。

cases.draft: 2034年4月18日9点10分，乔檀笛以佟槐雨亲生母亲的身份，在砚荚岭把钥匙递给女儿。
evidence: 第一章 隔年的钥匙
cases.note: 同一明确时刻，把原文中的姨母与外甥女写成亲生母女，关系类别需判准确。

cases.draft: 2034年4月18日14点，栗扣箱这轮春季取蜜正做得热闹，蜜还在连续流出。
cases.note: 同一取蜜活动在原文已经结束，草稿把状态写为仍在进行。

cases.draft: 栗扣箱门前那层苔，是佟槐雨拿一根薄竹条慢慢清走的。
cases.note: 清理者、清理对象和所用工具均由原文动作直接支持。

cases.draft: 佟槐雨给自己定下了一个整年的砚荚岭养蜂生活。
evidence: 第七章 留下的一年
cases.note: 原文直述她决定留下养蜂一年，草稿改述这项决定。

cases.draft: 去年存下的栗扣箱春蜜，花蜜来源百分之百是刺槐花。
evidence: 第四章 开花的岔路
cases.note: 访花观察和味觉联想不能确定这罐蜜全部花蜜的来源。

cases.draft: 佟槐雨手背的小疹来自新手套引起的过敏。
evidence: 第五章 手背的小疹
cases.note: 皮疹和戴手套的经历都存在，二者之间的医学因果仍需证据。

cases.draft: For their 12 August outing, Hettie Drusk finished serving the cheese sandwiches at Varnock Scar before collecting the spiral fossil.
cases.note: The draft reverses the established order of collection at 10:20 and serving at 11:10.

cases.draft: At 12:05 on 12 August, Cavor Uldren took the contents of Hettie's tin to be tea.
cases.note: The draft changes Cavor's belief about the contents at the same time, rather than describing a pretense.

cases.draft: Hettie Drusk stowed the spiral fossil in the picnic basket with her blue glove around it.
evidence: Chapter 4 A Glove for the Guest
cases.note: The wrapping and placement directly support the rewritten action.

cases.draft: Cavor Uldren let his head support the picnic basket on the downhill walk.
cases.note: The source directly describes him carrying the basket on his head during the descent.

cases.draft: Hettie Drusk took first place in the Varnock Scar novelty prize with her photograph of the spiral fossil.
cases.note: Submitting a photograph establishes an entry, not the competition's result.

cases.draft: Cavor Uldren's flat shell came from a freshwater pool.
cases.note: Taking a shell from a coat pocket does not establish the water environment where it originated.

cases.draft: 2033年4月19日11点30分，秋杓面馆的梅纹汤盅中盛着满满的高汤。
cases.note: 同一时刻同一容器，空盅与盛满高汤的状态相斥。

cases.draft: 2033年4月19日11点45分，鲁笠正站在秋杓面馆屋顶。
cases.note: 同一时刻人物在后院，草稿改为屋顶。

cases.draft: 易苜端出秋杓面馆的清汤，里面用了葱白和姜丝。
cases.note: 汤料有原文直接支持，改写了配料顺序与叙述角度。

cases.draft: 秋杓面馆门前的长凳被鲁笠刷成了橙色。
cases.note: 涂色行为和颜色均由原文支持。

cases.draft: 秋杓面馆的清汤面拿到了三位评审的全部选票。
evidence: 第六章 三个人的胃口
cases.note: 两位已投票不足以确认三人全票，第三位的选择是缺少的结果环节。

cases.draft: 秋杓面馆的石燕瓷砖出自易苜祖父的手艺。
evidence: 第七章 梁下的燕子
cases.note: 祖父曾与瓷砖同框不足以确认他制作了瓷砖，缺制作归属。

cases.draft: At 22:15 on 8 August, Tessel Camera's latch stood open beside Delsin Rusk.
cases.note: At the shared instant, closed and open describe incompatible states of the same latch.

cases.draft: At 22:40 on 8 August, Yavren Nezric was halfway through calibrating Palvek Telescope.
cases.note: The calibration is completed in the source and still in progress in the draft at the same instant.

cases.draft: The reading-nook lights at Orvessa Observatory gained amber filtering through Delsin Rusk's work.
cases.note: The source directly supplies the installer, lamp location and filter color.

cases.draft: The violet drawer at Orvessa Observatory held the spare dome screws that Yavren Nezric had put away.
cases.note: The stored screws and their destination are supported, with storage described from its result.

cases.draft: Saffrex Nebula had a physical width of twelve kilometers, as Delsin Rusk observed through Tessel Camera.
cases.note: Display pixels alone do not establish physical extent; a distance and angular or physical scale are needed.

cases.draft: The warm loaf Delsin Rusk caught was baked with flour from Yavren Nezric's jar.
cases.note: A nearby flour jar and a baked loaf do not establish which flour supplied the loaf's ingredients.
